name: Tony Redwood
original_name: トニー・レッドウッド
source:
A member of the Advance Police Unit, BCP's equivalent of the Swat Team. He is a "Frozener", a race of artificially-conceived humans who possess genes best suited to the environment of outer space. 

He is an ace pilot who can manipulate an EMPS (Extravehicular Mobility Police Suit, the mecha used by the BCP) as if it was an extension of his own body, which has earned him the nickname "Mr. Goddard", after the EMPS model used by AP.

[From [url=https://metalgear.fandom.com/wiki/Policenauts]Fandom[/url]]
